summary: Patria Investments Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of board member Pablo Echeverría Benítez and the appointment of Alfonso Duval as interim director, effective June 12, 2026. Duval, a partner and Head of Clients for the Andean Region, joined Patria in 2021 from Moneda Asset Management. Echeverría remains Managing Partner and Head of Latam Equities. This is a routine board composition change with no takeover, activist, or strategic event. The filing does not involve any special situation; it is an ordinary governance update for a foreign private issuer.
